free_tier.stated: OpenAI-compatible AI inference for developers: route production AI traffic through a decentralized inference network with TEE-backed providers, no vendor lock-in, and the same API shape existing apps use; endpoint https://api.mor.org/api/v1.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: Morpheus also pays up to 12% APR on deposited stETH, WETH, USDC or USDT, so capital placed there earns MOR that can be restaked for inference; the loop needs capital at the start.

limits.value: Every route needs MOR: either per-token payment or a stake that converts to a daily inference session, and MOR must be bought on an exchange first.

record.notes: The MOR-per-inference conversion rate is not published on the pages read; mor.org/calc.html is the comparison tool and runs client-side. Without that rate the staking route cannot be priced, and a per-token comparison at USD 0.15 per 1M input is close to centralized list prices, so the stake is a convenience, not a discount, unless the rate is generous.
